posts.title: What Maintaining SwiftTerm Taught Me About AI Contributions
posts.description: If you maintain an open-source project right now, your pull request queue probably looks very different than it did two years ago. I maintain SwiftTerm , an open-source terminal emulator library that is now seven years old. Today, I estimate that about 80% of the pull requests I receive involve AI in some capacity.
